verdict.rationale: Capacities documents first-party Chat Connectors that link external AI chat apps (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Le Chat) to a space. It also documents an official MCP integration, and its docs say external assistants can change notes, with version history available to restore earlier versions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the connectors work, and detail on connector setup and scope (permissions, supported operations).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect external LLMs and AI tools to my notes through first-party connectors or an ecosystem of AI plugins

citations.quote: Chat Connectors let you connect AI chat apps, like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Le Chat, to your Capacities space.
If an external assistant changes a note in a way you do not want, use Version history on that object to preview and restore an earlier version.
